text:
kai: Hey folx, moving apartments this weekend Free to grab: corner L-shaped desk (oak veneer, 160cm x 120cm), two scuffs on inner corner, plus 2x DayPass wristbands for the Golden Gate Park concert on Sat (transferable). Pickup at SOMA office today or Monday between 10am-6pm. DM to claim. :wave:

jordan: i'll take the desk if no one with a bigger car has claimed it 

can pick up sunday afternoon with my hatchback. DMing now.

mel: i'd love one wristband please! can you transfer via the ticket app? can you hold it until monday if needed? :pray:

reception-bot: Please leave claimed items at Reception labeled with claimer name and desk location. Items left >48h may be donated. https://intranet/reception-pickups

kai: @jordan sunday ~2pm works. desk dimensions again: 160cm x 120cm (corner), pedals under surface are removable. no screws included (i think i left them in a tiny zip bag on top).

jordan: great, bringing two helpers to carry. i'll sign the pickup log and leave a note.

hr: PSA: if you're moving furniture across offices please submit an office-move form so facilities can reserve elevator access: https://intranet/facilities/move-request

mel: can confirm i can swing by today at 5pm to grab a wristband. i'll be wearing a green hoodie. :green_heart:

kai: holding both wristbands for @mel until 5:15. will leave the desk labeled "kai - claim: jordan" at Reception. thanks!

jordan: at Reception now, wearing a blue cap. desk loaded into car, thanks kai! left a :thumbsup: reaction.

ReceptionAgent: Item handed off to @jordan at 14:12. Logged by ReceptionAgent. Reminder: remove any personal PII from devices you hand to others.

mel: grabbed the wristband, transfer worked. see you at the park! :concert:

kai: all cleared out. thanks everyone. if anyone wants the little zip bag of screws i forgot i left it on top of the box at Reception. :sweat_smile:
